name: Zebra
overview: The Bible teaches that God is the sovereign Creator of all living creatures, including the diverse animals He made on the earth, as seen in His command for the earth to bring forth living creatures after their kinds. While zebras are not explicitly mentioned, they fall under the category of cattle and beasts created by God. Humanity, created in God's image, is given dominion over all animals, including zebras, with a responsibility to steward and care for them as part of God's good creation. This stewardship is rooted in God's blessing to be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.
